name: @almamesh/frontend
description: Your Vedic (traditional Indian) astrology chart, free and computed in your own browser — no account, no data harvesting.

scripts.gate: node scripts/check-tsc-native.mjs && bunx tsc -b packages/shared-types packages/constants packages/store packages/llm --force && bun run --filter '*' typecheck && bun run --filter @almamesh/web lint && bun run knip && bun run --filter @almamesh/browser test && bun run --filter @almamesh/store test && bun run --filter @almamesh/llm test && bun run --filter @almamesh/web test:unit && bun run --filter @almamesh/web build && node apps/web/scripts/verify-prerender-dist.mjs apps/web/dist

//gate: The frontend quality gate — CI's frontend job runs exactly this script (ENGINEERING-STANDARDS §3: gate mirrors CI, both directions). The standalone @gainratio/browser package runs its own upstream gate; this consumer gate proves the npm package integration and AlmaMesh adapter. The final `verify-prerender-dist.mjs` step checks the build itself: every public route must ship as a flat prerendered page (e.g. dist/welcome.html) listed in the SW precache. A bundler change once dropped them while the build still exited 0. The `knip` step is the TypeScript dead-code / unused-export axis (config in knip.json). Playwright e2e is deliberately NOT here — it needs generated 38MB engine assets and runs as the exit-gate / e2e-smoke / nightly CI lanes (see CLAUDE.md 'Playwright e2e tiering'). Dependencies remain untrusted for lifecycle execution; the browser Lego ships compiled dist on npm.
//knip: knip is the frontend dead-code / unused-export axis (config in knip.json). Pinned via bunx (6.26.0), matching the existing `bunx tsc` / `bunx playwright` toolchain pattern; graduating it to a locked devDependency is a follow-up. SCOPE is deliberately incremental, mirroring security-audit.yml's documented pip-audit scoping: the whole-dead-module axis ('files') is HARD-ENFORCED and kept green, while the symbol-level axes (unused exports/types/enum members) and the dependency-hygiene axes are surfaced as non-blocking WARNINGS on every gate run — a pre-existing backlog (~280 exports, ~87 types, a few dynamic-import-only deps). They auto-verify and print but do not block, so knip is not a permanently-red signal; a dedicated cleanup pass will retire the backlog and graduate those rules to 'error'.
//typescript: TypeScript 7 is the native compiler and ships no JS API. `@typescript/native` provides `tsc` (7.x); `typescript` stays on 6.x ONLY so typescript-eslint (peer <6.1) can load its API. Both packages install a `tsc` bin and bun links the native one first, so the gate runs scripts/check-tsc-native.mjs first and fails unless tsc is 7.x. Drop the 6.x pin when typescript-eslint supports TS 7.1+.
//engines: Bun is the sanctioned toolchain exception (ENGINEERING-STANDARDS §2) — pinned exactly in .bun-version (CI reads it via setup-bun's bun-version-file); engines.bun is the floor for humans.
//overrides: Force a single fresh caniuse-lite across the tree: autoprefixer + browserslist otherwise each pin their own nested (stale) copy, which trips the 'caniuse-lite is N months old' build notice even after `update-browserslist-db`. Refresh both this range and the DB periodically (a `bunx update-browserslist-db@latest` step in release/CI keeps it current).
//overrides.protobufjs: RUNTIME security floor. protobufjs arrives transitively via @huggingface/transformers > onnxruntime-web and had resolved to 7.6.2, which is vulnerable to GHSA-j3f2-48v5-ccww (moderate: DoS via infinite loop in .proto option parsing; vulnerable >=7.5.0 <=7.6.4, patched >=7.6.5). The `<8` bound is deliberate: onnxruntime-web declares `protobufjs: ^7.2.4`, and 8.x carries its own live advisories (GHSA-jfj6-75fj-8934; j3f2 again through <=8.6.5). 7.6.5 is the patched 7.x line (npm `latest-7`).
//overrides.postcss: No postcss override, on purpose. The GHSA-r28c-9q8g-f849 floor (patched 8.5.18) now comes from apps/web's direct `postcss` range, and the lock holds a single copy. An override on a package that is also a direct workspace dependency masks the direct range: the lock stayed at 8.5.26 while apps/web asked for ^8.5.28, and Dependabot's `bun install postcss@<new>` became a no-op that failed every frontend update job (NoChangeError, run 37092783955). Raise apps/web's range to move the floor.
//overrides.brace-expansion: DEV-CHAIN security floor. brace-expansion 5 exports a named `expand`; minimatch >=10.2.5 is the compatible consumer, and filelist >=2.0.2 prevents an old minimatch copy from re-entering the tree. Keep these three floors together. The 5.0.11 floor (2026-10-01) clears GHSA-qhr7-859c-m2p7, GHSA-6j4f-fj2g-mc7p and GHSA-q2hr-2g5m-vwhr (vulnerable >=4.0.0 <5.0.11) and still includes the earlier GHSA-rgw5-rvv9-x895 fix. No direct-dep release changes this: eslint, @typescript-eslint and vite-plugin-pwa reach it through minimatch ^5.0.5 ranges that already admit the fix.
//overrides.undici: DEV-CHAIN security floor. undici reaches the tree via wrangler > miniflare (exact pin) and jsdom. 7.28.0-7.29.0 carry ten advisories (GHSA-3wwx-pv8p-q78v, -pmjh-fq2x-6v4x, -r53p-7pc4-xj5r, -rfgv-xxqx-mfg5, -3xpg-4rpp-hhhm, -2jfj-6hjv-fm6j, -2gqq-gqf2-x968, -w293-vg96-wgc3, -8436-99hf-9mmv, -rx4f-c7p8-82vq; fixed in 7.29.1). The proper fix is the wrangler 4.145.0 bump, whose miniflare pins undici 7.29.1; this floor stops the single hoisted copy regressing below it. The <8 bound stays because miniflare pins the 7.x line.
//overrides.audit-2026-09-16: Transitive security floors from the reproducible `bun audit --audit-level moderate` gate. Every override stays on the dependency's existing major line except adm-zip, sharp, and fflate, whose vulnerable 0.x lines require the first patched release. The full frontend gate, real Worker parity, onboarding/offline recovery, and real report-PDF journey validate the assembled tree.
//overrides.audit-2026-10-06: Floors for the 2026-10-06 `bun audit` findings; no direct-parent release fixes any of them yet. sharp >=0.35.5 clears GHSA-wq5f-xc86-pv6w (high; reached via wrangler > miniflare, which pins 0.35.4 exactly, and @huggingface/transformers ^0.35.4 via @almamesh/memory; sharp is Node-only and never ships to the browser). source-map-js >=1.2.2 clears GHSA-68fv-2mgg-jv7q (high; via jsdom > css-tree, postcss, magicast). postcss-selector-parser >=7.1.6 clears GHSA-rj75-hqrm-r3gf (moderate; quadratic selector parsing): the 6.x line has no patched release, so this one floor crosses a major for Tailwind 3 (postcss-nested, @tailwindcss/typography); the compiled Tailwind CSS was diffed before/after and the full gate + production build validate it. braces (GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm) stays a scoped exception in security/audit-exceptions.json.
//overrides.wasm-zstd: Pin the exact runtime version proven by the standalone @gainratio/browser gate; the consumer lock must not float the browser Lego onto a different WASM payload.
